work-productivity-proactive-agent-workflow-helper v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill to support high-demand Proactive Agent workflows for Clawhub users.
- Helps users fix bugs, improve setup and safety, and create or improve reliable, agent-inspired workflows.
- Provides practical artifacts: workflows, checklists, analysis, implementation support, and templates.
- Focuses on locally-friendly solutions; avoids cloud-only or resource-heavy approaches.
- Includes clear validation and next-step guidance for each output.
